correctness.rationale: Every edge-distance square is strictly convex. An exact vertex-normal angular criterion limits local maxima to <=2 (even) or <=3 (odd), with triangle and square treated at the boundaries. Opposite-edge perpendicular feet yield sharp 4-point lower bounds; for odd orders the necessary and sufficient 6-point condition reduces to the explicitly factored weak-peak/strong-valley quadratic, proving the threshold and the strict endpoint. The all-order proof and the n^-4 expansion are analytic. Symbolic and 75-digit finite checks ran successfully from the actual included verify.py; no finite enumeration is used as an infinite proof.

This finding determines J(P_n,6), every H_n(p), and the exact asymptotic perimeter density across the entire canonical family.
